custom.title: Cakes for the
custom.description: Every celebration cake is designed with you and made by hand. From intimate birthdays to weddings, we keep it personal and seasonal.
custom.stepsTitle: From first note to first slice.
custom.step1Body: Share the occasion, guest count, flavors you love, and any inspiration. A week or two of notice is ideal.
custom.step2Body: We propose a design, flavor profile, and quote. We refine together until it feels right.
custom.step3Body: Your cake is made fresh in the days before your event, never frozen, and ready for collection.

custom.detail2Value: €60, depending on size, tiers, and detail.
custom.detail3Value: Collect at the boutique on Dzirnavu, Tuesday to Saturday.

custom.ctaDescription: Send us the occasion and a date. We’ll reply within a day with ideas and a quote.

story.metaDescription: How Arbooz grew from a home kitchen in 2013 into a Riga patisserie representing the city at the European Capital of Culture.
story.title: A hobby that became
story.description: Arbooz began as Karina’s home-kitchen experiments and grew, quietly, into one of Riga’s most loved small patisseries.
story.body1Text: Karina opened a small counter between Antonijas and Dzirnavu with a dozen macaron flavors and a conviction that everything should be made by hand, every morning. That has never changed.
story.body2Text: In 2014 Arbooz was selected as one of twelve brands to represent Riga during its year as European Capital of Culture — a quiet honor the team still holds close.
story.body3Text: More than a decade on, the ritual is unchanged: a seasonal menu, a counter arranged before eleven, and a room that smells of butter and almond.
story.quote: I am in the kitchen every morning before the boutique opens, and I would not have it any other way.
story.ctaDescription: We’re open Tuesday to Saturday. Come for a coffee and a macaron, or stay for a slice.
